svg.text: GraphQL Client Architecture — Frontend LLD
Normalized Cache & Query Lifecycle
Normalized store: flatten by __typename + id → {User:1: {...}, Post:42: {...}}
Query result → walk AST → resolve each field → store by cache key
Cache-first: read from store → stale? → background refetch → update UI
Network-only: always fetch, hydrate store, useful for real-time accuracy
Cache-and-network: serve stale immediately + refetch → second render on update
Eviction: LRU per query — gc() removes unreachable refs after component unmount
Pagination: merge: (existing, incoming) custom policy — cursor-based relay spec
Key fields: custom cache key beyond id (e.g. {Product: ['sku', 'region']})
Mutations, Optimistic Updates & Error Handling
Optimistic response: write expected result immediately to cache before server response
On success: server result overwrites optimistic entry — reconcile if diverged
On failure: rollback optimistic write — restore previous cache value automatically
Update function: manual cache.modify() after mutation to avoid refetch round-trip
GraphQL errors: distinguish network errors (HTTP 5xx) vs field errors ({errors: [...]})
Partial success: GraphQL returns data + errors simultaneously — handle both
Error codes: use extensions.code (UNAUTHENTICATED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND)
Retry link: retry on network error (not on GraphQL error) with exponential backoff
Subscriptions, Batching & Persisted Queries
Subscriptions: WebSocket (graphql-ws protocol) — operation_id per subscription
Subscription lifecycle: subscribe → receive events → complete (cleanup on unmount)
Merge subscription data into cache: writeQuery / updateQuery on each event
Query batching: batch link collects queries in 10ms window → single HTTP request
Persisted queries: hash query body → send only hash → server looks up full query
APQ (Automatic Persisted Queries): send hash → 404 → resend full query → cached
Request deduplication: same query in-flight → share single promise (no duplicate fetch)
Field-level loading: @defer / @stream for progressive data delivery (Apollo 3.7+)
N+1 Prevention, Auth Links & Devtools
N+1 on server: DataLoader batches DB calls per request (keys → VALUES IN (...))
Fragment colocation: component declares its own data needs → compose at query root
Apollo Link chain: authLink → retryLink → errorLink → httpLink (or wsLink)
Auth link: inject Authorization header; on 401 → trigger token refresh → retry
Schema introspection: disable in prod (info leakage), enable in dev for tooling
Query complexity limits: server rejects queries above cost threshold (prevent DoS)
Apollo DevTools: inspect cache, trace queries, replay operations — essential in dev
Code generation: graphql-codegen → typed hooks from schema + operations (zero runtime)
Normalize by __typename + id → merge updates
Optimistic UI: write → confirm/rollback on response
Subscriptions: WS per operation, cleanup on unmount
APQ: hash-first → fallback to full query body
Link chain: auth → retry → error → http/ws
